_note: Dates are Gregorian. time_utc only where the moment is well documented; otherwise noon UTC is used and the moon's sign may be approximate. Positive or neutral events only: no wars or disasters.

events.title: First telephone call
events.note: Alexander Graham Bell: 'Mr. Watson, come here.'

events.title: Lei Áurea: slavery abolished in Brazil
events.note: Brazil becomes the last country in the Americas to abolish slavery.

events.title: First public film screening
events.note: The Lumière brothers show films to a paying audience.

events.title: First powered flight
events.note: The Wright Flyer flies for 12 seconds.

events.title: Start of the Mexican Revolution
events.note: The date Madero's Plan de San Luis set for the uprising.

events.title: Gabriela Mistral's Nobel Prize announced
events.note: The first Latin American Nobel laureate in literature.

events.title: First ascent of Everest
events.note: Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reach the summit in the late morning, local time.

events.title: Yuri Gagarin's flight
events.note: The first human in space: 'Поехали!' ('Let's go!').

events.title: Brazil wins the 1970 World Cup
events.note: Pelé's Brazil wins its third title.

events.title: García Márquez's Nobel Prize announced
events.note: The author of One Hundred Years of Solitude.

events.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' and 'Goal of the Century'
Fall of the Berlin Wall
events.note: The border opens in the night.

events.title: Hubble Space Telescope launched
events.note: A new eye on the universe.
